meaning: Titles and reading notes drafted by an AI agent in the register of the paper they annotate. No mathematician has reviewed them.

notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.ClassPro: This definition quantifies over every interior point. classProductSplitAe_holds proves the almost-everywhere version. classProductSplit_of_trace retains an additional pointwise zero-trace hypothesis. The integrated class-cross estimate uses the almost-everywhere route; assigning its proof to the stronger pointwise interface would change the quantifier.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classCro: This closed proof uses the almost-everywhere route; the stronger pointwise class-product interface is not used to close this step.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVelo: This proof supplies the downstream coefficient bound directly; the stronger legacy velocity-identity interface has no closed realizer found in the supplied source.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sharpCir: This public name occurs in two source modules. The occurrence ledger preserves both; the single graph location uses SharpCircleSquare.lean:140, which is imported by the ordinary cell endpoint.
